name: revenue-matters-trailer
description: Revenue Matters brand-system motion graphics + logo outro for the podcast trailer/teaser (Remotion)

scripts.render:webm: remotion render src/index.ts G1-TargetAccounts clips/1-target-accounts.webm --codec=vp9 --pixel-format=yuva420p --crf=18 --timeout=120000 && remotion render src/index.ts G2-500DollarPlay clips/2-500-dollar-play.webm --codec=vp9 --pixel-format=yuva420p --crf=18 --timeout=120000 && remotion render src/index.ts G3-StoryQuote clips/3-story-quote.webm --codec=vp9 --pixel-format=yuva420p --crf=18 --timeout=120000 && remotion render src/index.ts Outro-Logo clips/4-logo-outro.webm --codec=vp9 --pixel-format=yuva420p --crf=18 --timeout=120000
scripts.render:previews: remotion render src/index.ts Preview-G1 previews/1-target-accounts-PREVIEW.mp4 --codec=h264 --timeout=120000 && remotion render src/index.ts Preview-G2 previews/2-500-dollar-play-PREVIEW.mp4 --codec=h264 --timeout=120000 && remotion render src/index.ts Preview-G3 previews/3-story-quote-PREVIEW.mp4 --codec=h264 --timeout=120000 && remotion render src/index.ts Preview-Outro previews/4-logo-outro-PREVIEW.mp4 --codec=h264 --timeout=120000
scripts.render:all: npm run render:webm && npm run render:previews
